items.detail: The S&P 500 rose **0.28%** to 7,712.57 Tuesday, but the Nasdaq ended flat as money moved from tech into value stocks, lifting the Dow over 1%.
items.why: Strong earnings and oil easing on US-Iran deal reports lifted old-economy stocks, while AI names stayed under pressure.

items.detail: **Netflix** fell more than 3% after hours despite beating forecasts with $14.6 billion in revenue, a shaky start to this week's big-name earnings.
items.why: Investors looked past the earnings beat and focused on Netflix's disappointing guidance.

items.detail: The **10-year Treasury yield** eased about 2 basis points to 5.11% as oil swung back and forth on US-Iran deal headlines.
items.why: A reported US-Iran peace proposal briefly sank oil below $100, easing inflation fears, though a diplomat said no deal is imminent.

items.detail: South Korea's **Kospi** jumped about 4% Wednesday to near 5,770, setting off its first buy-side trading curb in two months, after Tuesday's 3.73% drop to a six-month low.
items.why: Cheaper oil and after-hours gains in US chip stocks sent Samsung and SK Hynix up more than 6%.

items.detail: The **Nifty** climbed back above 23,000 to about 23,071 Wednesday, with the Sensex up 0.86%, as trading resumed after the Dussehra holiday.
items.why: Hopes for an India-US trade deal and a rally in Infosys lifted buyers, though Brent near $110 capped gains.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** jumped 1.65% to 2,773.42 Tuesday, beating the S&P 500 as investors moved money away from tech.
items.why: Slightly lower Treasury yields and cheaper oil eased pressure on small firms, which rely more on floating-rate borrowing.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** climbed back to about $82,930 Wednesday, recovering from a low near $81,100.
items.why: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $527 million Monday, their biggest day in nearly a month, led by BlackRock's IBIT.

items.detail: **Ether** rose about 2.4% to roughly $2,455, back above $2,400 after Tuesday's dip.
items.why: Selling eased as bitcoin ETF inflows and calmer oil lifted crypto broadly, despite continued Ether ETF outflows.

items.detail: **Solana** held just above $104 on the day its Alpenglow upgrade switches on, with buyers defending $100 all week.
items.why: Ten straight days of US Solana ETF outflows, nearly $55 million in October, are offsetting hopes for the upgrade.

items.detail: **Gold** slipped to about $4,113 Wednesday, down 0.66%, extending this week's slide below $4,150.
items.why: A 10-year yield above 5.1% and over 90% odds of a December Fed hike make non-yielding gold less appealing.

crossCuttingTheme: Oil swinging on US-Iran deal headlines is driving markets: cheaper crude nudged yields lower and lifted the Dow, small caps and Korean chipmakers, but yields above 5.1% keep pushing gold lower.
